Name: Ultrawide Centered UI
Author: MrInterBugs
Description:
[size=5][b]Ultrawide Centered UI[/b][/size]

Playing on a super-ultrawide monitor, like a 49" 5120×1440? The game stretches its HUD to the far corners, so the clock, toolbar and energy bar end up at the edges of your vision.

This mod keeps the [b]world full-screen[/b] but draws the [b]HUD and menus in a centred 16:9 area[/b]. It's like playing on a 27" monitor in the middle, with half a monitor either side showing just your farm.

[line]
[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Centred HUD and menus:[/b] the clock, toolbar, health and energy bars, inventory, shops, calendar, dialogue and chat all sit in the middle 2560 px of a 5120×1440 screen.[/*]
[*][b]Full-width world:[/b] you still see, walk and use tools across the whole screen.[/*]
[*][b]Seamless edges:[/b] menu backgrounds, screen fades and flashes cover the full width, matching the game exactly.[/*]
[*][b]Mouse follows you everywhere:[/b] the cursor, the held item and tooltips work over the side areas without being cut off.[/*]
[*][b]Tidy title screen:[/b] the title screen stays full-width, but its corner icons move in to the edges of the centre area.[/*]
[*][b]Your choice of centre:[/b] 16:9 by default. 16:10, 21:9, 3:2 and 4:3 are built in, or set any ratio in config.json.[/*]
[*][b]Quick toggle:[/b] press [b]F9[/b] to switch it on and off, handy for comparing.[/*]
[/list]
[line]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or later[/*]
[*]Optional: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], to change settings in-game[/*]
[/list]
[line]
[size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Install this mod with Vortex, or unzip it into your [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game with SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]The mod turns on by itself once a save is loaded and your screen is wider than the centre area. On a normal 16:9 or 16:10 screen it does nothing.

[line]
[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
Change settings in-game with Generic Mod Config Menu, or edit [b]config.json[/b] in the mod folder after running the game once.
[list]
[*][b]Enabled[/b]: turn the mod on or off.[/*]
[*][b]Centre aspect ratio[/b]: the shape of the centre area. 16:9 by default. At 1440p, 16:9 is 2560 px wide and 21:9 is 3360 px.[/*]
[*][b]Centre title screen icons[/b]: move the title screen's corner icons in to the centre area.[/*]
[*][b]Toggle key[/b]: F9 by default.[/*]
[/list]
[line]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5. Not tested with older 1.6 versions.[/*]
[*]Turns itself off in split-screen co-op.[/*]
[*]Mods that use the game's own tooltips and cursor work automatically. Mods that draw their own tooltips may get cut off when the mouse is over the side areas. Mod menus that draw their own cursor get a plain cursor there instead.[/*]
[*]This is a beta, so please report anything that looks wrong![/*]
[/list]
[line]
[size=4][b]Reporting problems[/b][/size]
Please include:
[list]
[*]your SMAPI log, uploaded at [url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi.io/log[/url];[/*]
[*]the output of the [b]ultrawide_selftest[/b] command, run in the SMAPI console with a save loaded;[/*]
[*]your screen resolution, and your UI scale and zoom settings;[/*]
[*]a screenshot, if you can.[/*]
[/list]
